name: companion
description: Crab companion: the animated Lagoon backdrop in a left strip (5-hour limit as water bands, 7-day limit as shells, cache age as sun to moon and sleeping crabs, one jellyfish per subagent, a sandcastle per task step), a mood crab band with Lagoon and sound toggles, done alerts with a crab chirp, and celebrations. Hooks only: zero tokens.

lagoon.title: Lagoon backdrop
lagoon.description: Draw the Lagoon behind the session (desktop and mobile). The 🌊 button and /theme switch it; the last choice is remembered

stripWidth.title: Lagoon strip width (px)
stripWidth.description: Desktop draws the Lagoon in a strip this wide against the window's edge, where the session list sits; the rest stays plain

stripSide.title: Lagoon strip side
stripSide.description: Which edge of the desktop window the strip sits on

glassBlur.title: Glass blur (points)
glassBlur.description: How much the panels over the Lagoon blur it, 0 to 64

glassOpacity.title: Glass opacity
glassOpacity.description: How opaque the panels over the Lagoon are, 0 to 1; higher keeps the session list easier to read

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Crab chirps on done alerts, waits and celebrations. The 🔔 button switches it; the last choice is remembered

alertSeconds.title: Done alert after (seconds)
alertSeconds.description: Toast and chirp when Claude finishes a turn that worked at least this long

celebrations.title: Celebrations
celebrations.description: Crab dance, fireworks and a happy chirp when all tasks are done, tests pass after failing, or a git commit succeeds (at most one every 30 seconds)

criticalPercent.title: Critical limit (%)
criticalPercent.description: From this 5-hour or 7-day percent the crab turns red and angry

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto: the TTL the engine reports on a model switch, else 1h on a subscription and 5m otherwise

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, fr or ar (right to left)
